name: Task_7
description:
Measure the volumetric thermal expansion of bulk aluminum over 300-500 K at 1.01325 bar from volume changes at constant pressure and independently from pressure changes at fixed volume. Build a periodic 108-atom aluminum cell by repeating a conventional cubic FCC cell with lattice parameter 4.05 Å 3 x 3 x 3, and use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model throughout. Choose and justify numerical settings, temperature sampling, equilibration, production lengths, and measurement frequency. Record velocity initialization and random seeds, remove center-of-mass momentum, and initialize velocities only once for the NPT sequence.

Run one continuous isotropic NPT heating-then-cooling sequence without resetting positions or velocities. Include heating stages at 300, 400, and 500 K and return stages at 400 and 300 K; choose additional stages as needed. Establish equilibration and assess temperature and pressure control using measured data. Report stage mean measured temperatures and volumes. Define the main interval coefficient β_volume as the slope of a linear fit of heating mean volume against mean measured temperature over 300-500 K, divided by the heating 300 K mean volume. Report fit residuals. Separately estimate the local volumetric expansion coefficient at 400 K, recording the local analysis method and data selection. Quantify heating-cooling volume differences at 300 and 400 K.

Set V* to the heating 400 K mean volume. Design fixed-cell NVT calculations near (400 K, V*) with defensible temperature and volume perturbations to infer the isothermal bulk modulus B_T and pressure-route expansion coefficient β_pressure. Demonstrate that the sampled response supports local derivatives. Use total hydrostatic pressure including the kinetic contribution; document stress sign conventions and unit conversions. Treat positive B_T as a stability diagnostic and investigate any failure. Report the signed difference between β_pressure and the local NPT estimate without forcing agreement.

Report both expansion estimates in K⁻¹, the local NPT coefficient, B_T with units, and the comparison checks. Keep production cells, positions, momenta, and potential energies. Also keep time-indexed virial stress and total pressure, raw logs, and restartable states at each stage boundary so the analysis and continuity can be checked.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
